name: Okasare Hero ~Minna ga Boku no Seieki o Neratteru...!?~
original_name: 犯されヒーロー～みんながボクの精液を狙ってる…！？～
source:
Long ago Humans and Monmusu divided the world, and Heroes acted as go-betweens to broker a peace.
100 years passed...

Now, a new and unknown enemy has invaded. A legion of Weapongirls pour from another realm with power enough to crush both Humans and Monmusu. To protect his village, a Hero fights the invaders but, he is struck down.

At the moment of his doom, a Monmusu rescues him.
Her name is [url=/c43054]Rizesnea[/url]. 100 years ago, she was the world-conquering Queen.

"I'm safe," thinks the Hero, briefly, before the Queen strokes him with her feet. He orgasms. She's saved him for his white nectar, the key to victory while her own strength remains diminished.
Together they can conquer the Weapongirls...
but [url=/c43054]Rizesnea[/url] has one condition.

"I will regularly take your white nectar. I must drink you!"
The Hero reluctantly agrees, for the sake of the greater good.....

Thus begins the quest of the Okasare Hero, a target of both allies and enemies.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170779.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，人类与魔物娘瓜分了世界，英雄们作为中间人促成和平。
一百年过去了……

如今，一名全新而未知的敌人入侵世界。一支武器少女军团从异世界涌出，拥有足以击溃人类与魔物娘的力量。英雄为了保护村庄与入侵者战斗，却被击倒。

在濒死之际，一名魔物娘救了他。
她的名字是[url=/c43054]莉泽斯妮娅[/url]。一百年前，她曾是征服世界的女王。

“我得救了。”英雄短暂地这样想着，却发现女王用脚抚摸着他，让他达到高潮。原来她救他，是为了取得白色精华；在自身力量衰弱的情况下，那是胜利的关键。

他们联手就能征服武器少女……
但[url=/c43054]莉泽斯妮娅[/url]有一个条件。

“我会定期取用你的白色精华。我要喝掉你！”
英雄为了大局不情愿地答应了……

被盟友与敌人同时盯上的“受辱英雄”之旅，就此开始。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170779.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
